text:
My pick is the Moto G37 Power at ₹16,999. Three good phones under ₹20,000:

Phone	Price	Screen	Battery	Camera
Moto G37 Power	₹16,999	6.7-inch, 120Hz, 1,050 nits	7,000mAh, 33W charging	50MP Quad Pixel + 2-in-1 light sensor
POCO M8x 5G	₹19,648	6.9-inch, 120Hz (brightness not listed)	7,900mAh, 45W charging	50MP + 2MP macro
Vivo T5 Lite 5G	₹19,999	6.74-inch, 120Hz, 1,200 nits	6,500mAh, 44W charging	50MP
Moto G37 Power: best camera and cheapest. It is also built tough (MIL-STD-810H).
POCO M8x 5G: biggest battery and the fastest chip of the three.
Vivo T5 Lite 5G: brightest screen and water resistance (IP65).

The prices are from Smartprix's Flipkart Big Billion Days 2026 list. Prices in this range change often, so check again before buying. The Moto price is for the 4GB/64GB version; 4GB/128GB is ₹18,999.

Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
2:58 AM

The National Museum in Janpath, New Delhi is open Tue–Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Mondays and national holidays.

Tickets:

Adults: ₹20
Foreign nationals: ₹500
Students up to class 12: free with an I-card (schools can pre-book on the museum's site)

One thing to know: the Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries were closed for renovation in the last notice on the page (dated Wed 29 May 2023). I did not see a newer update, so check before you go if those matter to you.
